messages:
Anita: quick cross-team check — we need a concise dep matrix for the kernel bridgework before Thu deploy. who owns the kernel<->locator handshake? any unknowns on KV warmup or cache invalidation?
Mike: I own the handshake pieces but blocked on the locator schema change (#4123) — PR open, reviewer pinged. KV warmup has a perf regression on long tails, experimenting with prefetch window.
Chen: pinging on schema review now. re: KV warmup, can you drop the repro and perf numbers?
Mike: repro is in the canary logs: latency spikes at 99th from 220ms -> 540ms when prefetch = 0.7s. local repro steps in the PR description.
Sara: for ownership clarity — Anita assigned Kernel/Bridge (Anita), Locator (Chen), KV Warmup (Mike), Canary Ops (Lena). confirm? :white_check_mark:
Anita: yes that's the plan. Lena will own canary gating and rollback.
Lena: I can do the canary tomorrow morning (PST). need a dep matrix and a rollback playbook. also: if cache invalidation happens, we need a circuit to drop to cold-path, not retry heavy prefetch.
Kevin: need to flag the Dedicated infra team — there are CUDA driver pinning changes in the kernel patch that might affect dedicated nodes. cc @Infra.
Mike: noted, Kevin. patch touches allocator and kernel launch planner. link: https://git.internal/r/4123
Chen: schema change is minor but needs migration window. propose running migration with feature flag for 48h.
Anita: add migration window to dep matrix. also add test owners and smoke tests (end-to-end: continuous batch + kv warmup enabled).
Sara: quick ask for code review timing — can reviewers prioritize #4123 and #4150 (prefetch tuning)? would help unblock the canary.
Mike: I've left inline comments on #4150 about a flaky test: 'test_kv_warmup_timeout'. planning to skip it with a ticket to fix after deploy.
Lena: for the rollback playbook, draft steps: 1) cordon canary nodes, 2) revert kernel commit, 3) disable prefetch flag, 4) scale down canary -> 0, 5) monitor 5m windows. any additions?
Chen: add a DB migration rollback: restore previous schema state via feature flag toggle.
Kevin: infra step: ensure reserved kernel firmware on dedicated nodes isn't auto-upgraded during canary; set cordon tag: `kernel-canary-lock`.
deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled for 2027-05-12T15:00:00Z. Health checks: p95 latency, token/sec, streamer errors. Automated rollback threshold: 5% error increase or p99 +150ms.
Anita: nice, deploy-bot. last thing — someone compile the dep matrix into a single doc and drop into #eng-runtime/incidents as a pinned message? aim EOD CET.
Chen: I'll assemble the matrix; will include owner, PR, migration window, smoke tests, infra flags, rollback steps.
Mike: I'll push a small readme in the PR with repro and perf artifacts. also tagging review reminders.
Sara: thanks. if reviewer bottlenecks persist, I'll escalate to eng-ops.
Lena: once matrix is up, I will run a pre-canary checklist and post result.
Anita: perfect. tagging this as blocker->deploy until matrix + two LGTMs on key PRs. :rocket:
Mike: any volunteers to do a quick smoke run in staging today? need someone to run `./tools/shared-smoke --batching --kv-warmup` and observe p95 for 20m.
Kevin: I can run it in ~90m on staging-dedicated. will report.
Chen: matrix draft posted: https://docs.internal/s/dep-matrix-kernel-bridge — comments welcome.
Anita: thanks all — will follow up in morning stand and update the roadmap ticket.
